system.description:
You launch a killhook, magnetic spike,
tendon cable, monowire harpoon,
recoil anchor, or combat grapnel at a
location or creature within Far range.
If the target is a location, make an
Interface Roll (13). On a success, mark
a Stress to pull yourself to a position
within Melee range of it.
Ifthe target is a creature, make an
Interface Roll against it. On a success,
mark a Stress to deal 3d8 physical
damage to the target. You then pull the
target straight toward yourself or pull
yourself straight toward the target,
ending within Melee range of it.
